positions.name: CalibrationVerifiedAgainstReferenceStandard
positions.frame: what grounds the claim that the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration is correct — verification against a named reference standard?
positions.why: The prose assertion (src-1) and the two structured field-label restatements (src-2, src-3) all point in the same direction: the calibration claim rests on having been checked against the June reference plates, not on assertion alone. The directional reads converge — power reads 'expert'/'rational-persuasion' or 'informational' across all three, value reads 'competence' throughout, and conviction sits at 'claim' level (unhedged, evidence-backed, but not framed as a ratified decision) for every member. src-2 and src-3 compress the same evidentiary move into catalog form rather than adding new content, so the group is one directional read performed three times at different granularities, not three separate positions.
